title: Contract Pricing Note: Supply Lead Allowance for VendPoint Start-Up Items
content:
How an item is supplied adds a lead allowance to the par Corbett sets for the item most recently added to a VendPoint Industrial Vending Program machine in its start-up par review. The supply route is read from the machine's selection history and from the customer's Contract Pricing Agreement.

**Rule.** The lead allowance follows how the item is supplied: a non-catalog special item on its add entry carries the special-item lead allowance; a catalog item that carries, on the customer's agreement, a contract price line written as a Corbett-approved substitute for a discontinued item and no removal line for the item carries the substitute lead allowance; any other item carries none.

**Figures.** Special-item lead allowance 0.5; substitute lead allowance 0.25.

### Decision table

| Add entry marks the item as a non-catalog special item | Contract price line written as a Corbett-approved substitute for a discontinued item | Removal line for the item on the agreement | Lead allowance |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | either | either | 0.5 |
| No | Yes | No | 0.25 |
| No | Yes | Yes | None |
| No | No | either | None |

**Records read.** The special-item mark on the item's add entry; the customer's Contract Pricing Agreement price lines for the same item number, by why each line was written (a Corbett-approved substitute for a discontinued item) and whether any is a removal line.
